title: Owarimonogatari: Mayoi Hell (1)
overview: March 13th, the morning of college entrance exams. Koyomi Araragi has died due to Izuko Gaen. Mayoi Hachikuji was waiting for him in the afterlife, and guides him towards an unknown destination. Koyomi would have never thought that this certain someone would be waiting for him there.

title: Owarimonogatari: Mayoi Hell (2)
overview: Mayoi takes Koyomi to meet Teori, who offers him a way to return to the world of the living. Koyomi is in doubt about accepting his offer, as he believes others like Mayoi are more worthy of reviving than him, until he comes with a surprising decision.

title: Owarimonogatari: Hitagi Rendez-vous (1)
overview: Now fully human again, Koyomi is called by Hitagi for a date, as they spend some time together, Koyomi has a vision of Ougi.

title: Owarimonogatari: Hitagi Rendez-vous (2)
overview: Koyomi and Hitagi spend the rest of the date bonding further. Once back home, Koyomi has another encounter with Ougi.

title: Owarimonogatari: Ougi Dark (1)
overview: Gaen assembles Koyomi, Shinobu, Mayoi and Yozuru and reveals that Ougi is the responsible for some of the previous ordeals they faced.

title: Owarimonogatari: Ougi Dark (2)
overview: To stop Ougi from meddling further, Koyomi has a final confrontation with her.

title: Owarimonogatari: Ougi Dark (3)
overview: Ougi reveals their true identity. Araragi is forced to bear the consenquences. This is also known as the greatest anime episode ever.
